frequency_question: What proportion of major executive nominations are confirmed by the Senate within an 8-day or similar short operational window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations of cabinet-level and equivalent major agency heads submitted to the United States Senate; excludes minor advisory boards.
window: 8 days or less from submission to final vote
provenance_note: claims 20 cases from only 5 named (4.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 20 sampled across recent administrations; believed representative of compressed-window confirmations.
known_gaps: Varying degrees of political polarization and urgency across different congressional sessions.
skeleton: Standard executive branch nominations requiring Senate confirmation over recent decades, sampled by legislative urgency tiers.
validity_reason: Relates to enduring structural procedures of the U.S. Senate confirmation process.
